column1: # Known bugs of upstream versions, for scripts/interop.sh.
# Adapters are published on the latest upstream release even when it has a
# bug; the bug is listed here (and in docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) instead of
# pinning an older release or hiding it.
#   2  upstream version, as print-capabilities reports it
#   3  extended regular expression matched against the step name: births,
#   4  what is wrong (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md has the details)
# In a pairing that involves the adapter at that version, a matching step may
# fail and is counted as a known bug rather than as a failure. If it passes in
# every pairing that ran it, the run fails: the entry is stale.

column4: EdgeNode advances bdSeq again after NBIRTH, so the NDEATH of disconnect() carries bdSeq+1 and hosts keep the node online
